verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Exportable audit logs" on its top tier. The feature docs describe draft revisions, publishing with commit messages, and reverting to earlier revisions, which implies a recorded change history for flags. However, no evidence documents what an audit entry contains. Missing for 10: documentation that every flag change records the actor, timestamp, and old/new values; audit log docs beyond a pricing bullet; audit availability outside the top paid tier; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value

citations.quote: SSO & SCIM provisioning Exportable audit logs
